title: Read this Coolify
subtitle: See everything in a Coolify through its server's Tugra agent. No Coolify API needed.
linkHint: Coolify on one of your servers? Read it through its agent. Read-only, no secrets.

pick.label: Server
pick.placeholder: Choose the server that runs Coolify
pick.hint: It needs a connected Tugra agent.
pick.none: Add a server first. Its agent reads the Coolify on it.

optIn.title: Let Tugra read this Coolify
optIn.desc: Only after you allow it. Tugra reads the Coolify database on this server and keeps a copy to look at.
optIn.noSecrets: No secrets. Passwords, keys and tokens are only marked as present.
optIn.audit: Every step is written to the audit log.
optIn.stop: Stop any time. The copy is deleted.
optIn.notFound: No Coolify on this server. Pick the server that runs it.
optIn.noDocker: Docker is not available on this server.
optIn.dbStopped: Coolify is installed but its database is not running.

stop.title: Stop reading this Coolify?
stop.body: The copy Tugra keeps is deleted. Coolify itself is not touched.

item.moveHint: Preview only. Nothing moves from here. Open in import starts the import through this server's agent, with no Coolify API token.

checklist.title: Add all Coolify servers
checklist.desc: Pick a team for each server and get its install command. Nothing runs by itself: paste each command on its server.
checklist.empty: Only the Coolify server itself is here. It already has its agent.
checklist.ambiguousHint: More than one of your Tugra servers sits at this address, so none was picked. Remove the duplicate, then check again.

error.forbidden: Only a team owner or admin can do this.
error.no_docker: Docker is not available on this server.
error.not_read_only: Tugra could not confirm a read-only session, so it read nothing.
error.unreadable: The read did not finish. Try again.
